approaches_tried.approach: Per-entry stat/du/readlink forks for candidacy + sizing + live-reference detection
approaches_tried.reason: Measured ~44s against the real 1,733-entry live /tmp backlog and ~23s of that inside the /proc/*/cwd+fd live-reference scan alone (604 processes, 7,186 fds) -- the exact fixed-per-invocation-cost-paid-many-times-over defect class this task exists to eliminate, reproduced inside the reaper meant to fix it. Replaced with batched `find -printf`/`du --files0-from=-`/`readlink -f <many args>` calls, bringing a full dry-run against the real backlog down to ~3s.
